goal: Add ActionContract, a handler-free immutable declarative IR v1 describing an action's shape via exactly kind, name, version, ordered fields, ordered outcomes and ordered errorEnvelopeFields. It canonicalizes and deeply freezes caller-declared ordinary dense identifier arrays while preserving their order, rejects duplicates/unsafe identifiers/prototype tricks/accessors/symbols/sparse or extra-property arrays and unknown or missing top-level options, and renders deterministically. It describes an action; it never executes one, dispatches one, or renders code for one. Command and Query in src/application/action-primitives.mjs remain the sole effect boundary and are untouched by this package.
nonGoals: no handler, dispatcher, bus or router
no migration of the historical CreateCustomer protocol record
no change to src/application/action-primitives.mjs (Command/Query remain the effect boundary)
no repository-boundary.test.mjs assertion or behavior change beyond registering action-contract.mjs in the existing closed src/application manifest

scopeResolution.note: ActionContract is a standalone value class in src/application/action-contract.mjs with no import of any kind (framework-free, capability-free, and independent of action-primitives.mjs, which it deliberately does not touch or extend). It validates kind (exactly "command" or "query"), name (the same dotted-lowercase, >=2-segment, <=128-character coordinate shape action-primitives.mjs uses), version (a safe integer >=1), and three ordered identifier lists (fields, outcomes, errorEnvelopeFields), each an ordinary dense array of unique, 1-64-character, letter-led [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]* identifiers, cloned and deeply frozen with caller order preserved (never sorted, since declared order is part of the contract). toJSON()/toString() render the fixed key order kind, name, version, fields, outcomes, errorEnvelopeFields deterministically; equals() is exact-class and structural over that rendering.
